title: Counterfactual Explanation Output
description: Schema for the structured output of the counterfactual explanation generator.

explanation_id.description: Unique identifier for this explanation instance.

trajectory_id.description: Reference to the trajectory that triggered this explanation.

violated_rule_id.description: The ID of the specific rule that was violated, if any.

violated_rule_text.description: The natural language text of the violated rule.

counterfactual_action.description: The specific action that would have prevented the failure.

reasoning_chain.description: Step-by-step reasoning leading to the conclusion.

confidence_score.description: Model confidence in the generated explanation.

tokens_used.description: Number of tokens consumed during generation.

fallback_reason.description: Reason for fallback if status is 'fallback'.
